fusions.name: Trailing Cast
fusions.desc: Casts the mesh you drag behind you, dealing 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Its damage rises 5% for each stretch of ground you have walked, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Heel on the Cords
fusions.desc: Stamps down on an enemy at or below 25% health and treads your mesh into it, dealing 22 damage and using up every affliction on it to add their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Ankle Loop
fusions.desc: Lays a loop of mesh at the nearest enemy's feet. It waits up to 45 seconds, and the first enemy to step within 2 tiles takes 16 damage and is [Leaden] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Coiled on the March
fusions.desc: Each time you cover a long stretch of ground, you coil up the mesh you drag behind you and regain 3 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
